verdict.rationale: Resend's own docs explicitly confirm inbound email support ("Receive and act on inbound email: point MX records at Resend and process messages via webhooks") and an API to list received emails, plus webhook creation for event notifications. However, evidence lacks detail on parsed body/attachment handling, payload schema, or independent/hands-on confirmation of inbound parsing quality. Missing for 10: documentation of parsed message structure (headers/body/attachments) delivered to webhook, independent verification of inbound reliability, and any community corroboration of the inbound-mail feature specifically.
